info.title: CoPP_Policy
info.description: RESTful interface for AOS-CX switch software

properties.description:
Reference Resource: [CoPP_Policy](#/CoPP_Policy)
Specifies the read-only hardware-default CoPP policy, as identified in the [CoPP_Policy](#/CoPP_Policy). This policy is applied at first boot, and whenever [global_user_copp_policy](#/System) is missing.

cfg_cpes.description:
Reference Resource: [CoPP_Policy_Entry](#/CoPP_Policy_Entry)
The desired version of the Control Plane Policing Policy. CoPP Policy Entries (CPE) specified in this version of the policy are defined in [CoPP_Policy_Entry](#/CoPP_Policy_Entry)

status.description: The status of the last version of 'cfg_cpes' column, that has been processed by switchd.

code.description: Numeric error code.  Expected to be 0 when state is 'applied'

message.description: Detailed reason for error state.  Expected empty when state is 'applied'

version.description: The version of cfg_cpes that corresponds to this status.
